boundaries.text: The general principle, builder method, and participant-neutral architecture are different levels. A database, shared state, or DSL is not a universal requirement.
Compiler validity, operator correctness, evidence support, and acceptance for a purpose require different checks.
A described operation or accepted result does not establish authority for an external action.
Maintained declarations and generated executable behavior might be layers or alternatives. The notes do not select the relationship.
Lineage, corpus consideration, retrieval recall, evidence support, and conflict resolution are distinct properties.
A program revision, resolved system revision, environment binding, evaluation plan, and observed run are different records.
Using recorded observations differs from making new live model or tool calls. Matching configuration identity does not guarantee exact outcomes.
Human understanding, runtime enforcement, evidence quality, and program generalization need different tests.
The work profile is proposed, the field study has not been conducted, and injected failures do not validate every task dimension.
Working cognitive definitions, assigned work roles, security authority, and the emergence of agency are not interchangeable.
Alice is a separate research direction. Sharing a method does not make one direction a prerequisite of the other.
A runnable evaluation configuration is not evidence that its scoring rules are valid or its illustrative threshold is justified.
Permitted interaction sequences, safety, eventual completion, shared understanding, and evidence truth require different checks. A monitor proposal does not establish all of them.
A more structured program or isolated runner does not by itself grant authority. The accepted representation, current permission, and confirmed external outcome remain separate.
The captured DSL examples illustrate domain vocabulary and scenario construction. They do not measure general generation reliability or establish every possible protocol execution.
Interactive correction, user understanding, retrieval quality, and contract enforcement need distinct observations. The proposed paper and studies are not completed research.
